description: This Kotlin source file defines a data class and a composable function for managing and displaying Base64-encoded images in an Android Compose UI. It includes state management, image decoding, and error handling.

classes.name: Base64ImageState
classes.description: A data class representing the state of a Base64-encoded image, including the image bitmap and a failure flag.

methods.name: rememberBase64ImageState
methods.description: A composable function that returns a Base64ImageState object, decoding the provided Base64 string into an ImageBitmap asynchronously and updating the state accordingly.
